# Test images: credits and licences

Road-state test images for `services/vision`. Each is a 1024 px rendition of a file on Wikimedia Commons. **We pixelated every visible face and legible number plate** (boxes in `labels.json`, script `prepare_fixtures.py`); otherwise the images are unchanged. No face is the subject of any image.

The originals are the work of the authors below, under the licences named. The modified versions here are shared under the same licences (CC BY-SA files stay CC BY-SA). Marks or text visible in the photos belong to their owners.
